talking-to-gertrude.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-gertrude.text: Oh yes, before I forget - are you still in the adventuring business?

talking-to-gertrude.player: I am! Do you have another quest for me?

talking-to-gertrude.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-gertrude.text: Well, I don't - but I happen to know someone who might!

talking-to-gertrude.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-gertrude.text: Well, there are these two ladies who are looking for adventurers with cats.

steps.player: Ratcatchers, eh? Where would I find them?

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: They told me they generally hang about in the sewers below Varrock. I can't stand it down there, or I'd have looked into this ratcatching business myself.

steps.player: I wouldn't have thought you'd have much business down in the sewers.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I've had to drag Shilop and Wilough out of there more times than I care to count, the little rascals.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: I don't know which is harder, raising kids or cats.

steps.player: Thank you Gertrude, I'll be sure to have a look for these ratcatchers.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Very well. Is there anything else I can do for you?

options.text: Do you have any more kittens?
I'll be off. See you another time.

steps.player: I'll be off. See you another time.
Interesting, but I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe another time.

steps.speaker: Gertrude
steps.text: Very well. Is there anything else I can do for you?

options.text: Do you have any more kittens?
I'll be off. See you another time.

talking-to-gertrude-talking-to-gertrude-.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-gertrude-talking-to-gertrude-.text: Oh yes, before I forget I think there are some people you should meet.

talking-to-gertrude-talking-to-gertrude-.player: The two ladies you said I could find in Varrock's sewers? Yes, you told me about them.

talking-to-gertrude-talking-to-gertrude-.speaker: Gertrude
talking-to-gertrude-talking-to-gertrude-.text: Oh good. You can go and see them in the sewers whenever you're not too busy. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?

options.text: Do you have any more kittens?
I'll be off. See you another time.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Who are you?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: And what do you want?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.player: I'm Gertrude's friend. She said you two were-

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Ratcatchers?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Oh yes, we know lots about ratcatching.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: But why should we tell you?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: These are our trade secrets, you know.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.player: My cat and I are adventurers. If you could teach us a trick or two I bet it would come in handy!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: We'll have to confer.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: What do you think?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: I don't think cats even do tricks.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Don't be stupid! Can we teach [him/her/them] ratcatching?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: I don't know. Seems a bit weird.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.player: I can hear you, you know!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: We'll set [him/her/them] a task, see how it goes.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Great idea!
If the player has a cat training medal:

steps.player: I already have this medal that Gertrude gave me for catching 100 rats. Will that do?

steps.speaker: Grimesquit
steps.text: That's no good. How do we know you didn't buy it?

steps.player: You could trust me?

steps.speaker: Phingspet
steps.text: Boo! Bring on the task!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Right, if you catch 8 ratsies with your cat...

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: We'll tell you what we know.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Sound fair?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.player: I suppose so. How will you know that I've completed your task?

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: We'll smell your cat, of course!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Great! Let's have a sniff then.
The sisters pick up your cat and take a powerful whiff of it before placing it gently back on the ground.
If the player is wearing a catspeak amulet:

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: I'll live.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: If the player is not wearing a catspeak amulet:

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Miaoww!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Yup. Definitely a cat!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: A real pongy one, too.

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Go on then, go splat them ratsies!

grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-after-speaking-with.text: Splat 'em! Squash 'em!

grimesquit-phingspet-before-catching-8-r.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-before-catching-8-r.text: [Has he/Has she/Have they] splatted some ratsies?
If you've caught at least 1 rat:

steps.speaker: Phingspet
steps.text: [He needs/She needs/They need] [amount] more of 'em.

steps.player: How many, er, 'ratsies' do I have to catch again?

steps.speaker: Grimesquit
steps.text: 8 ratsies. And your cat has to catch them. Any you get don't count.

steps.player: Got it!

grimesquit-phingspet-before-catching-8-r.text: If you haven't caught any rats:

steps.player: Nope!

steps.speaker: Grimesquit
steps.text: Not even one!

steps.player: Rubbish!

steps.speaker: Grimesquit
steps.text: Boo!

steps.player: Alright, no need to rub it in.
How many, er, 'ratsies' do I have to catch again?

steps.speaker: Grimesquit
steps.text: 8 ratsies. And your cat has to catch them. Any you get don't count.

steps.player: Got it!

grimesquit-phingspet-upon-catching-the-8.player: Good job puss, we really showed those rats what for.

grimesquit-phingspet-upon-catching-the-8.text: If the player is wearing a catspeak amulet:

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: What for what now?

steps.player: Oh never mind, it's just a turn of phrase.

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Speaking of turning faces, we should tell those funny-smelling humans that we're done.

steps.player: Suppose so.

grimesquit-phingspet-upon-catching-the-8.text: If the player is not wearing a catspeak amulet:

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Miaow.

steps.player: Well cat, we should tell Grimesquit and Phingspet that we're done.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: They're not going to be able to sniff whether I was successful or not unless I bring my cat with me.
I splatted the ratsies for you.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Why are you talking like that?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Are you making fun of us?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Sorry, I just thought... won't happen again.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: So did you splat them ratsies or what?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Er, yes, I did... catch the rats.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Haha, nice!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Splat! Splat!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Can you tell me about ratcatching now?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Ha! Seems you already know plenty!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Oh yes, you're a real ratcatching prodigy.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Reminds me of us when we were little.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: I'm not sure that's a compliment...

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Well, there's nothing more we can teach you.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Not much at all!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: What? So we've just caught all these rats for nothing?
Isn't there anything you can teach me? I caught a lot of rats, you know...

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Here, have a rat pole.
Grimesquit hands you a rat pole.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: You can stick all the ratsies your cat splats on it.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: You're welcome!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Now now, keep your shirt on.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: We'll send you to Jimmy.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Ooh, yes, Jimmy will know how to help.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Where do I find this... Jimmy?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Jimmy Dazzler hangs out in Ardougne.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Ooh, and he is dazzling!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Shut up, Grimesquit!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Say hello to Jimmikins from me, won't you?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Would you look at that!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: At what?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: It's [player name] again!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: What do you want?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Can I have another rat pole please?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Here you go.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Stick the ratsies your cat splats on it!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Anything else?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: Where can I find Jimmy Dazzler again?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Didn't you find him in Ardougne?

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Phingspet
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: He's normally in the Flying Horse Inn.

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.speaker: Grimesquit
grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.text: Give him a kiss from me!

grimesquit-phingspet-talking-to-the-sist.player: I will absolutely not be doing that.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Ah, you must be [player name]. I've been expectorating you.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: I have. The Sisters Grime told me you'd be dropping in.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: They said you could teach me a thing or two about ratcatching.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: I didn't get this far by giving out help freely to every adventurer who came my way.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: Maybe I could help you out with something then?
I am an adventurer after all.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Ah, that's mincemeat to my ears!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: No thank you! Your unrefined caterwauling would only draw attention.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: How about I test your ratcatching mettle instead?
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Oh, your hands are full. Don't worry, I'll hold onto this map until you can jettison all that rubbish.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Take a good long look at this map.
Jimmy hands you a map. It seems to be a mansion in the woods nearby.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: No, you fool! A rat problem.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Precisely!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carry out this task with some element of safety.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.
Jimmy waves his hands about and mutters something under his breath.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: That's a trade secret, m'afraid.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: We already have a serious crime problem.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.player: Do you have any tips for me now?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-after-helping-grime.text: I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.text: Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?

steps.player: I've lost the map you gave me. Can I have another?

steps.text: With a full inventory:

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Oh, your hands are full. Don't worry, I'll hold onto this map until you can jettison all that rubbish.

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Here you go, don't lose this one.

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Is there anything else?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.text: If you have the directions stored somewhere:

steps.player: I've lost the map you gave me. Can I have another?

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Haven't I given you the map already? I'm sure I have. I can't afford to be throwing maps around nilly willy.

steps.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
steps.text: Is there anything else?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.player: What am I meant to do again?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.text: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-before-following-th.player: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-reading-the-scroll.text: The scroll contains directions to a manor in a densely wooded area near Ardougne.

options.text: Follow the directions to the house.

steps.text: If the player is within Ardougne:
If the player doesn't have a grown cat with them:

steps.player: I think I should have a cat big enough to catch rats with me before I go.

steps.text: If the player has not yet cleared the manor of rats:
The player gets transported to the manor.
If the player has cleared the manor of rats and informed Jimmy Dazzler:

steps.player: I don't want to go there again. I barely managed to get out the first time.

steps.text: If the player is not within Ardougne:

steps.player: These directions are from Ardougne. It would be much easier to find the place if I left from there.
I think I'll go there some other time.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-readin.player: Directions to... here, actually! I'd better hold onto them until I complete Jimmy's task.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-leavin.prompt: Do you want to leave the grounds?

options.text: Yes, let's get out of here!

steps.text: The player is transported back to Ardougne.

steps.text: Why me?

steps.text: I need a new job.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.player: Good job, Puss, I think that just about wraps things up here.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.speaker: Cat
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.text: Aw, really? I was enjoying that.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.speaker: Cat
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.text: I'm a cold blooded, claw toting, hitkitty.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.player: I knew you had a dark side.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.speaker: Cat
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-at-the-manor-after-.text: Well, we had better get out of here. Let's do it quietly.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.player: No, the job really is done!
Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!
If the player has a catspeak amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Bones
steps.text: I think of nothing but murder all day!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: If the player doesn't have a catspeak amulet equipped:

steps.speaker: Bones
steps.text: Mew!

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.player: He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.player: Where do I find this... Hooknosed Jack?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: He hangs around in a rather unfashionable part of Varrock. He likes a good scrap, does Jack.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: I'll tell him to look out for you.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.player: Can you tell me more about the Rat Pits?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: The pits lie below this very pub.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: See that ladder there? That's the way in.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.player: What goes on in these pits then?

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: I'd have thought it was self-exploratory. Here, have a manual.

jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.speaker: Jimmy Dazzler
jimmy-dazzler-s-task-returning-to-jimmy.text: Here, take this, you might find it useful.
You are handed the rat pits manual.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Depends who's asking. What do you want?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: Jimmy Dazzler sent me. He said you could help train my grown cat to catch rats.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: I expect he wants me to do that for free, does he?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: Well, I'm an adventurer. There must be something I can do for you in return.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Forget it.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: I'm too busy to babysit you and your moggy.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: No, really. Me and Pox have too much going on.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: We've got a big job to finish today, I can't teach you how to catch rats on top of that.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: Well I could be your apprentice! I've already got hands-on experience.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Oh yes? What sort of experience?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: I helped the Grime Sisters catch loads of rats in the sewers, and I cleared out a whole mansion in Ardougne for Jimmy Dazzler.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: I bet you did. Typical Jimmy, leaving the hard work to everyone else.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: So what do you say? Can me and my cat help you out?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Oh, alright then. But you'd better not give me or Pox any trouble!

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: I'd better not regret this...

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Right, your first task is to clear out a warehouse south of here.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: All you need to do is poison the rat holes with some bait. Can you handle that?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.player: I think so. Will any type of poison do?

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Are you daft? You need rat poison to kill rats!

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: If you can't mix a batch up for yourself, there's sure to be some lying around here somewhere.
If the player has Rat poison in their inventory:

steps.player: Would this stuff do?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: It certainly will! There's hope for you yet.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: If the player doesn't have Rat poison in their inventory:

steps.player: How would I mix my own rat poison?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Honestly, kids these days...

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Just bring me the base ingredients, and I'll mix it up for you.

steps.player: What are the ingredients then?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Get me some Kwuarm, some red spider eggs, and a vial.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Right, to poison the rats you'll need some tasty bait.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: They love a bit of cheese, so pour some poison on that and then leave it in the rat holes.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: Report back to me when you're done.

hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-receiving-jack-s-task.text: And no slacking!

options.text: Can you make me some rat poison?

steps.player: Can you make me some rat poison?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Have you got the ingredients for me yet?
If the player has a vial, kwuarm, and red spiders' eggs in their inventory:
You hand Jack the ingredients and quick as a flash he hands you back a vial of the rat poison.
If the player does not have the above ingredients in their inventory:

steps.player: No, not yet. What do I need again?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Get some Kwuarm, Red Spider Eggs and an empty vial. Bring them to me, and I'll make a batch of rat poison for you.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Do you see that bar to the south of here? Well, behind that is the warehouse. The rats are on the first floor.

steps.player: I've finished the job. Now will you teach me more about ratcatching?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: You're pulling my leg!

steps.player: Who, me?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Yes, you! You think I can't tell you're lying? Now get back to the warehouse and kill those rats!

hooknosed-jack-before-poisoning-the-rat-.text: You pour a tiny drop of rat poison on the cheese.

hooknosed-jack-before-poisoning-the-rat-.player: Um... let me think about this one.
Putting random things in rat holes isn't my idea of fun.

hooknosed-jack-before-poisoning-the-rat-.text: You place the cheese near the rat hole.
You hear the scuttling of little animal feet, followed quickly by the sounds of something devouring the cheese.

hooknosed-jack-poisoning-the-rat-holes.text: You place the poisoned cheese near the rat hole.
You hear the scuttling of little animal feet, followed quickly by the sounds of something devouring the cheese.

steps.player: Well that's one less rat hole. I had better finish the job off quick before they start to reproduce again.
Hmm, that should do the trick. Those rats should soon die off.

hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.player: I poisoned the rats in the warehouse! Do you have time to teach me about grown cats yet?
Are you serious? I've gone and done a job for you, the least you could do is say thanks.

hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.text: It's my cat, Pox. She's half dead, bless her.

hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.text: They found her at the warehouse you were working at. She must have eaten some of the rats you poisoned.

hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.player: Can I help? I feel somewhat responsible...

hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-after-poisoning-the-rat-h.text: There's an apothecary here in town, he could help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiders eggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.

hooknosed-jack-using-any-item-on-the-poi.player: Putting things in poisoned rat holes isn't my idea of fun.

hooknosed-jack-talking-to-pox-while-they.text: The cat is too sick to respond.

hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary.speaker: Apothecary
hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

steps.player: I need to talk to you about cats.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: As I said before, I'm the apothecary not the vet.

steps.player: Well, do you know anything about poisons?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Of course I do! What kind of poison do you need help with?

steps.player: How about rat poisons and anti-posisons for cats?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I think I can help you with that. What happened?

steps.player: Okay. Hooknosed Jack's cat, Pox, ate some rats which were poisoned with a Kwuarm and Red Spider Egg based concoction.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Not Pox! I remember when she was a kitten... hang on, I have no time for dilly dallying.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I know just the thing to help Pox out.

steps.player: Great! How can I help?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: I need a Bucket of Milk, some Ground Unicorn Horn, and a bit of Marrentill.
If the player has all the ingredients:
The apothecary carefully mixes the ingredients together. He then hands you a bottle of cat anti-poison.

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Quick, get this to Jack. If I know him, he wouldn't have sent someone else to do this if Pox wasn't seriously ill.

hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary-talking.speaker: Apothecary
hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary-talking.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

steps.text: Missing all the ingredients:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get a Bucket of Milk, Ground Unicorn Horn and some Marrentill before I can create a cat anti-poison potion for you.
With only Bucket of milk:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get some Ground Unicorn Horn and Marrentill before we can proceed.
With only Unicorn horn dust:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get a Bucket of Milk and some Marrentill before we can proceed.
With only Marrentil:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get a Bucket of Milk and some Ground Unicorn Horn before we can proceed.
Missing Unicorn horn dust:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get some Ground Unicorn Horn before we can proceed.
Missing Marrentil:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get some Marrentill before we can proceed.
Missing Bucket of milk:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: You need to get a Bucket of Milk before we can proceed.

hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary-talking.speaker: Apothecary
hooknosed-jack-to-the-apothecary-talking.text: I am the Apothecary. I brew potions. Do you need anything specific?

steps.text: If the player has the cat antipoison in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: What are you hanging around here for? You've got the anti-poison, so go give it to Jack. Quickly!
If the player doesn't have the cat antipoison:

steps.player: Could you make me another cat anti-poison potion?

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: No problem! I'll need some more ingredients though.

steps.player: Uh... I don't have all the ingredients on me at the moment.

steps.text: If the player is missing ingredients:
(Apothecary lists missing ingredients, same as above.)

steps.speaker: Apothecary
steps.text: Well hurry up and fetch them! Poor Pox is in serious danger. That poison she consumed was incredibly strong.
If the player has all the ingredients:

steps.player: I knew I forgot something. I'll be back in a second.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Just hurry up, will you?

steps.player: Yes, I've got it right here.

steps.text: You hand the vial of cat anti-poison to Jack.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Thank you [player name]. Thank you so much.

steps.player: No worries there, I'd be sorry to see poor Pox come to harm.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: Well, thanks to you, she'll live to see another day.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: I have to have a word with you about the job you did in the warehouse.

steps.player: I did a good job, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: The thing is, you didn't quite finish the warehouse job.

steps.player: Wait, but I poisoned all the rat holes just like you said.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: You did, but one rat survived... the biggest, nastiest one of the lot.

steps.player: Well, I'm not scared of big, nasty rats.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: I hope not, because someone's got to get rid of it, and me and Pox are out of action.

steps.player: Don't worry - we're on the case.

steps.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
steps.text: I really underestimated you, [player name]. Best of luck.

hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.text: Have you killed the King Rat yet?

hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.text: Look, you did me and Pox a big favour, but that's not an excuse to slack off.

hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-talking-to-jack-before-ki.text: Oi! You can't distract me like that. Get on with you, and get rid of that rat!

hooknosed-jack-fighting-the-king-rat-usi.text: The rat inside the room looks vicious. It could definitely hold its own against your cat.

hooknosed-jack-fighting-the-king-rat-usi.prompt: Are you sure you want to do this?

steps.text: Your cat squeezes through the broken wall.
Perhaps you could also supply your cat with food through this opening.

steps.player: Be careful in there, cat!

options.text: Go get that nasty rat, don't back down!

steps.player: Go get that nasty rat, don't hold back!

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Hisss!

steps.speaker: King rat
steps.text: Pfssst!

steps.player: Go get him, kitty!

steps.text: You change your mind. You and your cat aren't ready to deal with the King Rat just yet.

hooknosed-jack-fighting-the-king-rat-if-.text: Your cat flees from the king rat, barely escaping with its life.

hooknosed-jack-fighting-the-king-rat-usi.text: You drop some supplies through the broken wall to help your cat.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.text: They say you've killed the King Rat.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.player: Just barely! I was getting worried for my cat, but we pulled through.
Yes! The King Rat was holed up behind a wall, so I had to send my cat in to get it.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.text: Well, imagine that. You two must have a great bond. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two after all.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.text: See that manhole over there? Climb down it to enter the Varrock Rat Pits.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.player: Thank you so much! I imagine my cat will learn a lot in there.

hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.speaker: Hooknosed Jack
hooknosed-jack-returning-to-jack-2.text: Say, if you want to know more about the ratcatching business, you should seek out Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim. He was a skilled ratcatcher, back in the day.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: I'm trying to smoke these pesky rats out. Ahem-hem-hem.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: I'll - ugh - I'll be fine, youngin'. My lungs just aren't up for ratcatchin' like they used to be.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.player: I could help you. I'm young-ish and my lungs are doing fine so far.
What's up with your lungs anyway?

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: Years of blowin' smoke into rat holes, youngin'.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: You offered to help me out.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.player: That's right! Me and my cat have been learning from the best of the best.
The Sisters Grime, Jimmy Dazzler, Hooknosed Jack...

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: Blimey, that's my old crew! How are they all?

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.player: Better now that I've helped them out, I think.
Now, how should I get rid of these rats?

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: simple. Take this pot, light the contents, and blow the smoke into the hole.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: Aye, this pot. What's wrong with it?

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: You'd better make your own then. A-hem-hem.

smokin-joe-meeting-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-meeting-joe.text: Just take a simple pot and stick some ordinary garden weeds in it. Then light the pot and use it on a rat hole.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: Have you got that job done yet, youngin'?

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: Better with you helpin' me out, youngin'.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: Say, when the job's done, how about I show you to the Rat Pits here in Keldagrim?

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.player: That seems a fair deal. But I'd appreciate any pointers you could give me.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: An extra pair of eyes or set of claws can often come in handy.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.player: Do you have any more straightforward hints?
Never mind, I'll figure it out!

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: You place the garden weeds into the pot.
The player smokes the rat hole
The rats quickly scamper back into their hole as soon as the smoke clears.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.player: Hmm... this isn't working as well as I'd hoped.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: There is a draught blowing out of this rat hole.
If the player does not have a catspeak amulet equipped

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Miaaaaow!

steps.player: Hold on, let me equip my Catspeak Amulet so we can talk.

steps.text: The player smokes the rat hole
The rats quickly scamper back into their hole as soon as the smoke clears.

steps.player: Hmm... this isn't working as well as I'd hoped.

smokin-joe-talking-to-joe-again-before-s.text: If the player has a catspeak amulet equipped

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Hey [player name], talk to me.

steps.player: Can't you see I'm busy adventuring?

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Look, I know you're having fun, but you're doing this all wrong.

steps.player: Well then smarty paws, what should I be doing?

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: What we have here is a two cat job.

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: You're smoking the rats out, but the smoke clears fast enough for them to run back in before you can catch them.

steps.player: I can see that for myself, thanks.

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Listen, why don't you leave the rat-catching to the expert? Tell me when you're going to start the fire and I'll run and catch the rats.

steps.player: Great idea. I'll get right to it.
Hey cat, you know the drill, get going!

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Exterminate! Exterminate!

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Sorry, I got a little carried away there.
The player smokes the rat hole

steps.player: Hey cat, great job. What an ambush!

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Mua-ha-ha!

steps.player: You know, you really scare me sometimes.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: I'd better show you our rat pits here in Keldagrim.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: They're nice, but the ones they have in Port Sarim are even better.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.player: They have rat pits in Port Sarim?

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: Oh yes! It's the best place to train your wily cat.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: Well, I suppose there's no harm tellin' you.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: Look for 'The Face' in Port Sarim. She'll show you.

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.player: So where are the Keldagrim rat pits then?

smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.speaker: Smokin' Joe
smokin-joe-returning-to-smokin-joe.text: Down the stairs to the basement of the 'Laughing Miner'. Get yourself a drink, too, you've earned it.

port-sarim-the-face.speaker: The Face
port-sarim-the-face.text: Boss wants to talk to you. She's downstairs in the pits.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: Hello, The Face said you wanted to speak with me.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Ah, we meet at last. My fellow ratcatchers tell me you're quite the talent.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: Well I can't take all the credit, I've had more than a little help from my cat.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Ah, modesty. A trait seldom displayed by adventurers like yourself.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Too many more like you and I'll lose half of my business.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Epic poems aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: Smokin' Joe said that you know lots about training wily cats.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: I do indeed. In fact, that's why I wanted to talk to you.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: So you'll show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Ah, ah, ah - not so fast.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: Let me guess... you want me to catch some rats for you first?

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Nothing too difficult. Just rid the port of every single rat... at once.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Yep. I expect to see all the rats in Port Sarim dead in one, decisive action.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: So why do you want all the rats wiped out at once?

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: I want to write a new poem.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: No, silly. A poem about the art of ratcatching.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Poetry might be my bread and butter, but catching rats is my real passion.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.player: Couldn't you just use some 'creative license' instead?
Not to disappoint you, but this task might be beyond my capabilities...

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Don't be so hard on yourself!

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Besides, it's not difficult. I myself performed the very same feat just a few years ago.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash.text: Ha! Nice try. You'll have to figure that out for yourself.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.text: Any luck killing all the rats yet?

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.player: What do I have to do again?

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.text: Kill all the rats in Port Sarim in one, swift action.

port-sarim-meeting-felkrash-speaking-wit.player: Right. I'd better figure out how I'm going to do that...

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.speaker: The Face
port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.text: Have you spoken with the boss yet?

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.player: Yes. Actually, I wanted to ask you about the task she gave me...

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.speaker: The Face
port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.text: Stop right there. You'll get not hints out of me.

steps.player: You know, you're very pretty...

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: Ha! That's a good one.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: I hope you're better at ratcatching than lying.

options.text: That's a nice cat you have there.

steps.player: That's a powerful-looking cat you have there.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: Bellemorde? Beautiful, isn't she?

steps.player: Er... yes.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: I've had her since she was a kitten. Felkrash trained her for me.

steps.player: Oh really? Does she know any cool tricks?

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: Oh yes! There was this one time she helped Felkrash wipe out all the rats in town by -

steps.speaker: Bellemorde
steps.text: Hiss!

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: Oh, I see. Nice try, [player name], but you'll have to be cleverer than that.

steps.player: Almost had it...

options.text: I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.

steps.player: I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: What?

steps.player: All the other ratcatchers I've met had loads of tricks to show me.
In comparison, Felkrash was just... disappointing.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: How dare you! Felkrash is the greatest ratcatcher Gielinor's ever seen!

steps.player: Oh yeah? What's the most impressive thing she's done then?

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: I'll have you know she once killed all the rats in Port Sarim with just one attack!

steps.player: I don't know. That just sounds like one of her stories.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: It's true! I saw it happen. She used a magic flute to charm the rats into the sea!

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: Wait... I uh, I shouldn't have said that.

steps.player: Don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash you snitched.

steps.speaker: The Face
steps.text: You'd better not!

steps.player: They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.speaker: The Face
port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.text: Felkrash told me of the task she set you.

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.speaker: The Face
port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.text: I shouldn't have told you that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.player: If it makes you feel better, I lie to a lot of people.
I think I know how to carry out your task.

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.speaker: Felkrash
port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.text: Oh yes? Has The Face been telling tales again?

port-sarim-returning-to-the-face-for-ide.player: Oh no, she didn't say a word.

learning-to-charm-animals-using-a-coin-o.text: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.

options.text: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
I want to talk to you about animal charming.

steps.player: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
Can you help me learn how to charm animals?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: That depends. How much are you willing to pay?

steps.player: I'm not paying you again!
Listen, do you know someone called Felkrash?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Felkrash the Bard? Pah!

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I taught her all she knows about animal charming, and then she used my knowledge to kill!

steps.player: What's wrong with killing rats? That is her job, after all.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Music should never be used to kill.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: When I first met Felkrash we sang about love, not war.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Oh, things were a lot better in those days.

steps.player: So there's nothing I could do to get you teach me how to charm rats?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Absolutely nothing.

options.text: What if I offered you a drink?

steps.player: What if I offered you a drink?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'd say thank you very much and take it.

steps.player: But would you teach me?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: That might depend on how the drink tasted.

steps.player: So what's your favourite drink then?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Beer, just plain old beer.
If the player has beer with them
You offer the snake charmer a beer.
The snake charmer takes the beer

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Ahh, that hit the spot.

steps.player: So will you teach me now?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Nope.

steps.player: But... but...

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Sorry!
If the player does not have beer with them

steps.player: I don't have any beer on me.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: That's too bad!

options.text: What if I offered you some food?

steps.player: What if I offered you some food?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'd say I wasn't hungry.

options.text: What if I offered you some money?

steps.player: What if I offered you some money?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Now we're talking.

steps.player: How much money are we talking about?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll teach you for [amount] coins.

steps.player: I don't have that much money!

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: You're a resourceful looking adventurer. I'm sure you'll figure something out.
If the player has the ring of Charos equipped

steps.player: I'll go get more money...

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll be waiting!

options.text: (Charm) How about I give you 50 coins?

steps.player: What if I offered you 50 coins?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Yes... that sounds fair...

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: It's not that difficult. Here, take these.
If the player has a Snake charm in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'd give you a flute to go with it, but I see you've kept the last one I gave you!

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Study the sheet music carefully. Playing it on the flute will draw rats to you like flies to a bucket of camel dung.
If the player does not have the ring of Charos equipped

steps.player: I'll go get more money...

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll be waiting!

options.text: Forget about it. I don't care that much.

steps.player: Forget about it. I don't care that much.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: What? I'm offering something invaluable, and you'll quibble over a couple of coins?
You start slowly walking away from the snake charmer.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll do it for half the price.
You keep walking.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll do it for quarter the price.
You don't even break stride.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'll...

steps.player: You'll what?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: An eighth?

steps.player: No!
I'll give you no more than 100 coins.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Deal!

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: It's not that difficult. Here, take these.
If the player has a Snake charm in their inventory:

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: I'd give you a flute to go with it, but I see you've kept the last one I gave you!

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Study the sheet music carefully. Playing it on the flute will draw rats to you like flies to a bucket of camel dung.

options.text: What if I said I'd kill you?

steps.player: What if I said I'd kill you?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: If you killed me, you'd never learn my technique.

steps.player: You've got me there...

learning-to-charm-animals-reclaiming-the.text: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.

options.text: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
I want to talk to you about animal charming.

steps.player: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
I've lost some of the gear you gave me.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: What do you need?
if the player lost the flute:

steps.player: I've lost the flute.

steps.text: if the player lost the music:

steps.player: I've lost the music.

steps.text: if the player lost both the flute and the music:

steps.player: I need a new flute and some music.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: There you go. Now if you don't mind, I'm busy performing.

learning-to-charm-animals-talking-to-the.text: The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.

options.text: Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
I want to talk to you about animal charming.

steps.player: I want to talk to you about animal charming.
Hello.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Yes?

steps.player: How do I charm rats again?

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Do you remember that flute I gave you?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: And the music?

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
steps.text: Well, play the music that's on the sheet and that should do the trick.

steps.player: Thanks!

back-to-port-sarim-attempting-to-charm-t.player: I don't think I should play that tune here.

back-to-port-sarim-charming-the-rats.text: Rats appear as if from nowhere, drawn to your music.
Each rat in turn throws itself into the water and drowns.

back-to-port-sarim-talking-to-the-face-a.speaker: The Face
back-to-port-sarim-talking-to-the-face-a.text: That was an amazing performance! I've only seen one like it... as you know.

back-to-port-sarim-talking-to-the-face-a.player: Don't worry, Felkrash has no idea how I figured it out.

back-to-port-sarim-talking-to-the-face-a.speaker: The Face
back-to-port-sarim-talking-to-the-face-a.text: And it had better stay that way!

back-to-port-sarim-playing-the-correct-s.player: I don't want to play that tune again - I'll have a pack of rats chasing after me!

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.player: Ha! I did it. Did you see?

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.text: I did indeed! A performance for the ages.

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.speaker: Felkrash
back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.text: Now that you're a real ratcatcher, I'd be happy to train that cat of yours.

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.player: Can you train my cat to be a wily cat?

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.text: If the player does not have an overgrown cat:

steps.speaker: Felkrash
steps.text: I can only train overgrown cats into wily cats.

back-to-port-sarim-returning-to-felkrash.text: If the player has an overgrown cat:

steps.text: Your overgrown cat has grown into a lean mean hunting cat.

steps.speaker: Felkrash
steps.text: A heroic cat like yours needs a heroic name, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Felkrash
steps.text: Shall we rename it?

steps.speaker: Cat
steps.text: Hey [player name], you finally got around to naming me.

steps.player: Sorry I took so long, [Cat name], it took a while to come up with a name for you.

Ip8ceI.speaker: Ali the Snake Charmer
Ip8ceI.text: Good luck finding someone else to help...
